headline: Broad AI-power pullback hits the book; theses intact
summary: Every holding fell in a market-wide data-center selloff, dragging the book down 2.37% to $10,938 — but this was noise, not a single business breaking. NVDA is still up 8.9% and CEG up 5.3%; nothing today changes what you own.
watch: RZLV reports tomorrow: tiny position, hold — do nothing.
AVGO reports in 2 days: hold NVGO through it — no trim before earnings.
Hold NVDA at $221.28 — winner intact, do nothing.
VRT at $258.26 and CEG at $274.95 are your best add targets once cash frees up.
Optional: trim $150 of NVDA near $221 to fund a VRT add if it keeps falling.
NNE at $18.31 is speculative — keep it small, no adding down.
recap: Book fell 2.37% to $10,938 — a broad AI/power-infrastructure down day, not one bad name.
VRT -4.1% to $258.26 and NNE -4.8% to $18.31 were the hardest hit.
NVDA -2.9% to $221.28 but still up 8.9% overall; CEG -2.6% to $274.95, still up 5.3%.
AVGO barely moved (-0.2% to $370.73) with earnings in 2 days.
RZLV flat at $2.88, sitting at break-even, with earnings tomorrow.
Cash is $3 — no dry powder to buy this dip right now.
Today's big movers (TP, STDN, GPRK) are not your names — no action.
